steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The colour wheel organises hues: primary (red, yellow, blue), secondary (orange, green, purple), tertiary (red-orange, blue-green etc). | Key Fact: Complementary colours sit opposite on the wheel and create maximum contrast and visual vibration when placed together. | Key Fact: Colour has emotional and psychological impact — warm colours (reds, oranges) feel energetic; cool colours (blues, greens) feel calm. | Key Fact: Tints (add white), shades (add black) and tones (add grey) expand your palette beyond pure hues.
